reason: 149 euros every month plus 495 or 990 up front is close to 2,300 euros in the first year for an automatic text message, and I already call people back in the evening. For a small firm like mine that's another fixed cost I'd cut the first time things get quiet.
objection: A brand-new company with no customers wants a monthly fee from me for something my voicemail and WhatsApp half do already. I can't see that it wins me jobs I'm losing now, and if those two founders give up next year I'm left with forwarding I have to undo myself.
would_change_my_mind: A free month on my own number with no setup fee, so I can count how many jobs actually came in through it before I pay anything.
